description: This is a test class for the EmployeeDependentDao component in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, testing CRUD operations and search functionalities for employee dependents.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the EmployeeDependentDao methods related to employee dependents management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, populates test data, and sets up the DAO instance.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent entity.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an employee dependent with a specific sequence number and related attributes.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown when saving an employee dependent with an invalid sequence number.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests retrieval of dependents for a given employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific dependent by employee ID and sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests deletion of dependents for a specific employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Verifies search functionality with various filters and counts.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependentWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limit parameter for pagination or limiting results.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentCount
methods.description: Checks the count of dependents matching certain search criteria.
